title: Jeremiah's Symbolic Act: Prohibition of Marriage and Mourning
description: The Lord gives the prophet Jeremiah a command not to marry, not to enter a house of mourning, and not to take part in festive meals. This is to be a living sign of the coming judgment on Judah: death, disease, and exile without burial or lamentation. When the people ask why disaster has struck them, Jeremiah is to answer that their fathers abandoned the Lord and followed other gods, and that they themselves have acted even worse. Therefore, they will be cast out into a foreign land. The passage also contains a promise of future restoration, when the Lord will bring the people back from the land in the north.
